packets.title: P04: one task through a genuine handoff
packets.request: Add atomic reservation, native-task adapter, source isolation, retained refs, evidence records, worker outcomes, and scoped review. Run one real low-risk Lemon task to an honest review/verification handoff. Do not introduce broad parallelism until this works.
acceptance: Completed worker output is imported into a stable factory/<task>/<attempt> ref bound to the validated commit, tree and base, never a reported SHA.
A check runner records command, cwd, source identity, dirty status, toolchain, timestamps, exit status and retained redacted logs; results are reused only when inputs match.
Review findings are persisted with evidence and disposition; repairs supersede rather than overwrite receipts.
One real low-risk Lemon task reaches READY with honest review/verification evidence.

packets.title: P05: parallelism and predictable verification
packets.request: Enable the small initial WIP limits, overlap checks, resource queue, build-process cleanup, request/runtime budgets, and changelog fragments. Prove three independent edits do not create shared-file churn or simultaneous shared-build writers. Failures must preserve work and get a named owner.
acceptance: Three independent edits run concurrently without shared-file churn or simultaneous shared-build writers.
A killed runner's descendants are reconciled or terminated before build capacity is reused.
Request/runtime budgets are enforced locally and missing cost counters are reported as unknown, not zero.
Per-task changelog fragments are aggregated deterministically.

packets.title: P06: CI observation and bounded repair
packets.request: Extend the existing failure reporter, add exact-identity CI observation, classify waiting versus failure, deduplicate triage, and route repairs. Keep automatic reruns and merges off initially. Test stale runs, absent lanes, cancellation, rate limits, inherited-failure ambiguity, and one actual failure/repair cycle.
acceptance: CI evidence binds repository, PR head, base, tested SHA, workflow identity, run ID, attempt, lanes and conclusion.
An old failure arriving after a new head cannot change the new head's status or cause duplicate repair.
Queued, cancelled, missing and timed-out results are never reported green.
One actual failure/repair cycle completes with automatic reruns and merges still off.

packets.title: P07: source imports and selected integration policy
packets.request: Add explicit issue/plan import, safe refresh/amendments, and the configured approval/integration path. Re-check live repository governance and the audit's CI gaps. Demonstrate a completed user outcome after merge verification, not just a stack of worker receipts.
acceptance: Issue imports store repository/issue identity, fetched revision, content digest and source text; refreshes of in-progress work become amendments.
Untrusted issue or log text cannot grant new authority.
Integration rechecks current task/head, review dispositions, gates, main health and live protections; no admin fallback.
One completed user outcome is demonstrated after merge verification.

packets.title: P08: operate, measure, then optimize
packets.request: Run five ordinary improvements through the system. Compare human interventions, end-to-end lead time, READY-to-land time, repairs, conflicts, and escapes. Only then add candidate batching, more slots, another host, stronger cache reuse, or another harness adapter when a measured bottleneck justifies it.
acceptance: Five ordinary improvements have run through the factory with recorded interventions, lead time, READY-to-land time, repairs, conflicts and escapes.
Any optimization added is justified by a measured bottleneck.
